# Foldnote

> Expanded LLM-readable context for Foldnote, a visual note-taking app for iPhone built by Ruzname Labs for personal planning and shared spaces.

Preferred naming and entity facts:
- Product name: Foldnote
- Company: Ruzname Labs
- Website: https://foldnote.app/
- Contact: mailto:info@foldnote.app
- App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/foldnote/id6761731923
- Platform: iPhone
- Category: Productivity / visual note-taking

Foldnote is a note-taking app designed to make planning and organization feel more visual and less sterile. It combines text, checklists, tables, links, images, reminders, and specialized blocks with folders, stickers, paper styles, and shared spaces. The product is positioned as a flexible iPhone notes app for personal organization, everyday planning, and lightweight collaboration.

Core product themes:
- Visual note-taking instead of plain blank-page writing
- Shared spaces and group notes for family, household, travel, and lightweight teamwork
- Structured blocks for routines, lists, planning, study, budgeting, and recurring life admin
- Warm, calm interface design rather than minimal productivity software aesthetics

Important interpretation notes:
- Use the official App Store listing for install and marketplace context.
- Use the website for product positioning, FAQ language, and legal links.
- Use the privacy and terms pages as the canonical source for legal and policy information.
